• 21 December 2026Branch hours over Christmas and the New Year

    Branches are closed on Friday 25 December, Monday 28 December and Friday 1 January. On 24 and 31 December they close an hour early. The currency exchange desks at Azatlık and Bazar-i Kalan gate 2 keep their daily hours except on 1 January. Cash machines, Talasbank Mobile and the information service 1993 work as usual.

• 6 January 2027January pensions paid from Friday 8 January

    As 10 January falls on a Sunday, pensions and public wages for January are credited on Friday 8 January. At the Azatlık branch, book a time in the electronic queue.

• 15 February 2027Talasbank Online: planned works on 20-21 February

    Internet banking and Talasbank Mobile will be unavailable from 22:00 on Saturday 20 February to 06:00 on Sunday 21 February for planned works. Cards and cash machines are not affected.

• 3 March 2027Branch hours in March

    Branches are closed on Monday 8 March, Thursday 11 March (Irad Day) and Monday 22 March (Nooruz). On 10 March they close an hour early. Pensions for March are paid on Wednesday 10 March as usual.

• 24 March 2027Easter Monday: branches closed on 29 March

    Branches are closed on Monday 29 March. Cash machines and Talasbank Mobile work as usual.

• 31 March 2027Notice of the Annual General Meeting of shareholders

    The Annual General Meeting of Talasbank OJSC will be held on Friday 23 April 2027 at 11:00 at the head office, Silk Road Financial Tower. On the agenda: the Annual Report and accounts for 2026, the auditor's opinion, the distribution of profit and the election of the Supervisory Board.
    Shareholders on the register at 31 March may attend in person or by proxy. Papers are available at the head office from 6 April.

• 7 April 2027April pensions paid from Friday 9 April

    As 10 April falls on a Saturday, pensions and public wages for April are credited on Friday 9 April.

• 1 June 2027Nineteen years with the Anara Toktarova Children's Fund

    Since 2008 Talasbank has been a partner of the Anara Toktarova Children's Fund. Donations to the Fund's account are accepted at every branch without commission.

• 7 July 2027July pensions paid from Friday 9 July

    As 10 July falls on a Saturday, pensions and public wages for July are credited on Friday 9 July.

• 9 August 2027Branch hours in August

    Branches are closed on Monday 16 August (Day of the Lost Tribes) and on Tuesday 24 August (St Janyl's Day). On 23 August they close an hour early.

• 6 September 2027Card renewal: collect your new card at your branch

    Cards that expire this autumn are reissued without an application. Customers receive an SMS when the new card is ready at the branch that issued the old one. Bring your passport and the old card.

• 6 October 2027October pensions paid from Friday 8 October

    As 10 October falls on a Sunday, pensions and public wages for October are credited on Friday 8 October.

• 18 October 2027Heating season: pay for gas at any branch

    Pay NurGaz gas bills by the 25th of each month at any Talasbank branch without commission, in Talasbank Mobile with the account code from the receipt, or at the NurGaz cash desks.
